subject: record() gains a phase; optional scores on DetectionEvent
body: Your field names are kept, with emotionId renamed to targetStateId. Under D-coord-012 calibration has phase peak|contrast|neutral: playbook 1.2-1.5 is peak and 3.1-3.2 is contrast. So the call is sensing.record(stateId|null, phase, seconds) -> CalibrationSummary {source, startedAt, durationSeconds, quality, stats {hr {mean,sd}, lnRmssd {mean,sd}, rmssd, windows}, rating?}. One thing I need: do you want the optional DetectionEvent.scores {toPeak, toContrast}, now that you get the person's own off-state too? If not, I'll drop it.
